basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Says who is accountable for each kind of fact and which source wins when sources disagree.
Keeps conflicts between sources as records instead of resolving them silently.
Grants write access per fact scope, separate from read access.

may: Look up the accountable owner and precedence for a fact.
Record a conflict between two sources with both values.
mustNot: Overwrite a fact from a source that does not hold the write grant.
Resolve a conflict by picking the newest value without a precedence rule.
Infer ownership from who last edited a value.
requiresHuman: Changing source precedence for a fact scope.

considerations: Clear accountability lets people correct wrong facts about them.
Hidden precedence rules can let one system silently override another team's truth.
affectedParties: Employees and contractors whose actions or data appear in company records
Customers, suppliers and partners named in company records
Auditors, regulators and courts that rely on the record later

owners.steward: The data governance council assigns fact accountability; each fact scope names its own accountable owner.
masterSystems: Systems of record per fact scope

items: Grant ID per writer and scope.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A fact authority entry names a fact scope, an accountable owner, steward, source precedence and write grants.
Look up accountability, evaluate precedence, record and retain conflicts, issue and revoke write grants.
Two systems both believing they are master.
Orphaned facts with no accountable owner.
Any Company Dimension that merges facts from more than one system.

sections.whatItIs: A companion profile for a Company Dimension that states, per fact scope, who is accountable, who stewards it, which source takes precedence, who may write, and which conflicts between sources remain open.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-02: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
